author: pkmcenter
safetyNotes: Pure styling. The plugin contributes one global theme (CSS only) and a small info panel. No network, file, clipboard, or agent access.
changelog: Release 1.0.3: fix invisible text inside the dark user bubble - attachment/image/file/command chips, inline links and inline code were pinned to dark host colors and became unreadable on the ink background; re-apply paper tones scoped to the user bubble only. Widen the message and composer column to 820px (!important, overriding the host 720px cap). Release 1.0.2: add README screenshots (chat view and theme picker); force the warm code-block and inline-code palette against the host light-theme cascade (defensive specificity + !important). Release 1.0.1: fix parchment code-block and inline-code overrides against the host light-theme cascade. Release 1.0.0: first release. Warm parchment global theme built on the host design tokens: cream paper background with faint 22px grid, solid ink user bubbles with paper-colored text, soft paper assistant cards, warm code blocks and tables, monospace meta lines, and composer/message width alignment in both sidebar layouts.
